entry.title: Taliesin
entry.summary: A Rust dev server that renders Markdown with executable code cells to HTML and patches the open preview block by block. This site is built with it.

entry.title: Quiet Roads for Road Cycling
entry.summary: A map of quiet, well-paved roads around Helsinki for road cycling, with the nearest train or metro station for each road.

entry.title: supercollider-mcp
entry.summary: An MCP server that lets an LLM render SuperCollider audio from code and measure the result.

entry.title: Federated Wind Speed Forecasting in Finland
entry.summary: Finnish weather stations train their own wind forecasts and share only model parameters with their neighbours in a graph. Neither of the two graphs I tried gave a practical improvement.

entry.title: Activity Challenge Telegram Bot
entry.summary: A production Telegram bot running guild-based fitness competitions across Aalto societies, with a Kubernetes-deployed backend and an analytics dashboard.

entry.title: Hierarchical Bayesian Analysis of Aviation Safety
entry.summary: A hierarchical Bayesian study of fatality rates across aircraft manufacturers, showing partial pooling beats complete pooling by ~1,944 ELPD.

entry.title: iPhone Premium Analysis: Hardware vs. Price
entry.summary: Regression models trained on 1,359 smartphones show that Apple devices are priced above their hardware-justified value.
